messages:
acme_ops: Hey Redwood — after the 3/15 rollout our tool calls to our invoicing tool are intermittently arriving with missing args (invoice_id). Used to be stable. Example below, and request_id attached.

acme_ops: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"Create invoice for user acct_123 amount 250","request_id":"req_0a9c1234"}'```

erin_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact payload you sent and the model_version shown in the response (or the request_id). Also any logs showing the function invocation would help.

acme_ops: Request ID: req_0a9c1234. Payload body above — we rely on the model to call `createInvoice(invoice_id, amount, customer_id)` via toolcall. Previously the generated function call always included invoice_id (GUID). Now invoice_id is empty string or not present.

jordan_eng: Looking. Was this observed right after the 2026-03-15 rollout? We promoted v2.8.0 yesterday which included a small change to argument serialization/whitespace trimming. Assigning to me to triage.

maya_sre: Pulled logs for req_0a9c1234 — I see a function emission but args show `createInvoice(invoice_id=, amount=250, customer_id='acct_123')` (invoice_id blank). Earlier traces looked like `createInvoice(invoice_id="inv_abc123", amount=250, customer_id='acct_123')`.

erin_support: Customer is blocked on billing flow. Can we do a targeted rollback or route them to previous variant while we debug?

jordan_eng: We can. Repro steps for engineering: 1) use system prompt forcing toolcall schema; 2) deterministic temp (0.0); 3) send long context (~5k tokens) — I can repro locally that invoice_id is sometimes dropped when prefix length exceeds threshold.

acme_ops: Repro attached — when we include older invoices in context (history) the invoice_id becomes blank intermittently. If we truncate context to <4k tokens the call is fine. Looks correlated with long context.

jordan_eng: That points at the KV cache / prefix trimming logic we changed in v2.8.0 to compress argument serialization for long sequences. I'll bisect the change and try a canary build with the previous argument-serialization path. Meanwhile I can request traffic routing for acct_123 back to v2.7.1.

deploy-bot: Canary routing request accepted. Traffic update: acct_123 -> model:v2.7.1 (100%) — propagation ~2m.

erin_support: Confirming with customer and escalating to ACME ops. I'll monitor and post their confirmation here. :thumbsup:

jordan_eng: ETA: 48 hours for root-cause PR and patch. If anyone else sees similar reports, please drop request_ids and context size. Will post PR and changelog when ready. :pray:
